character_quests_contract_check.name: character_quests_contract_check
character_quests_contract_check.value: ("character_quests"."kind" = 'contract') = ("character_quests"."contract_day" is not null and "character_quests"."contract_slot" is not null)

guild_boss_rewards_claim_check.name: guild_boss_rewards_claim_check
guild_boss_rewards_claim_check.value: "guild_boss_rewards"."claimed_at" is null or ("guild_boss_rewards"."status" = 'earned' and "guild_boss_rewards"."earned_at" is not null)

item_instances_shelf_check.name: item_instances_shelf_check
item_instances_shelf_check.value: ("item_instances"."on_shelf" and "item_instances"."shelf_account_id" is not null and "item_instances"."equipped_slot" is null and not "item_instances"."in_warehouse") or (not "item_instances"."on_shelf" and "item_instances"."shelf_account_id" is null)
